model-pools.title: Model Pool Status
model-pools.subtitle: Inspect desktop-local pools, sticky bindings, and provider readiness in one place.
model-pools.desktopOnlyDescription: Model pool status is derived from the desktop local provider registry, local bandit state, and local conversation bindings.
model-pools.emptyDescription: Add or sync local provider models first. Pools appear when at least one active local model is available.

descriptions.focus: Health, capacity, and readiness for the pool currently in focus.
descriptions.directory: Pick a pool to inspect its providers and pinned sessions.
descriptions.members: Providers currently participating in the selected pool.
descriptions.bindings: Sessions that are currently pinned to a specific provider model.

empty.members: No providers are currently attached to this pool.
empty.bindings: No sessions are pinned to this pool right now.
